title: Harbor & Pine Dental — booking site
stuck: A nice-looking site that nobody booked from. New patients still had to call during office hours.
now: One clear “Book an appointment” button, online booking 24/7, and every request lands straight in the clinic’s calendar.

title: Lead follow-up — on autopilot
stuck: Enquiries sat in an inbox for a day. By the time someone replied, the customer had booked elsewhere.
now: Every new lead gets a personal reply in under a minute, is logged in the CRM, and the owner gets a one-line summary.
